reactor_type: home built hot walled viscous flow chamber
evidence: Deposition of Erþ3:Y2O3 films was carried out using ALD method. ALD is a sequential, surface-saturating, deposition technique that uses successive pulse-purge sequences to deposit highly conformal films in a layer-by-layer manner. All films were deposited on sapphire (A and C plane single and double side polished), in a home built hot walled viscous flow chamber described elsewhere.
